sebi.rate: ₹10 per crore (0.0001%) on total premium turnover

spread.default: 25 bps per side; real bid/ask used when available

multiLegMultiplication: All per-leg costs multiplied by leg count; spread/slippage applied independently per leg

deltaProxyLabeling.label: MODELLED_DIRECTIONAL_PROXY
deltaProxyLabeling.applies: All 6 strategy families in the research registry (directional.ts)
deltaProxyLabeling.notes: Delta proxy P&L = ATM_DELTA (0.50) × sign × (exitSpot − entrySpot) × lotSize × lots. Premium fields optionEntry/optionExit are null on every proxy trade.

grossVsNetReporting.grossPnl: Delta-proxy spot move P&L before any costs
grossVsNetReporting.reportingPolicy: All three reported separately on every trade; no netting before disclosure

missingPremiumPolicy.zeroFill: PROHIBITED — zero LTP rejected by resolvePremiumFromRow
missingPremiumPolicy.interpolation: PROHIBITED — no averaging across strikes or sessions
missingPremiumPolicy.proxyFallback: PROHIBITED for real-premium paths; proxy is a separate labeled mode

stressTestProtocol.qualification: Strategy must remain net-positive at stress levels to qualify

notes: Cost model is complete and uses canonical FNO_COST_PARAMS. No local rate constants exist in premiumReplay.ts or backtestCharges.ts. All qualification would fail regardless due to 0 snapshot rows.
